description: [Signal Desk] How a ticker moved over a date range against a benchmark, and the excess return taken in the direction of the signal on the range's first day. One reading held over one window: a realized outcome, not a forecast. For questions like 'was the model right on TSLA this quarter'. Requires a connected fAlpha account.

benchmark.description: Index the excess return is measured against.
benchmark.title: Benchmark

horizon.description: Holding period the reading is for, in trading days: hp5d (5), hp15d (15), hp2m (42, about two calendar months).
horizon.title: Horizon

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: falpha_signal_desk_performance
title: Signal performance over a range
